snippet.title: Brisk - MSX2 - Triple Soft - 1993
snippet.description:
The first game by Triple Soft that really impressed me! His stuff was mostly published by MSX Club Magazine and later MSX Computer & Club Magazine. This game is a true gem. It has very nice puzzle elements, great music (covers - I especially like the cover of Harold Faltermeyer's "Fletch Theme"), flashy colours and it's just complete, including level editor.

Even today, it's still a great game to play (just as Leprechaun is).

As some more of the Triple Soft games, it was written using Turbo Pascal 3 for CP/M, with some custom made libs for sound and graphics.

Superb game. What more can I say?

Oh, the game is in Dutch. The intro screen says "A lively game", the rest speaks for itself, I think.... (Let me know if you have questions ;-)

Recorded with openMSX.
